history.summary: POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of seq 332 / file 332.json ('Baba Mast Nath Temple', id baba-mast-nath-temple-asthal-bohar-rohtak) - both rows refer to the same Math at Asthal Bohar; the file is written separately per the project convention with a unique id. The Baba Mast Nath Math is the samadhi and Math complex at Asthal Bohar (6-7 km east of Rohtak city on the Rohtak-Delhi NH-10, Rohtak tehsil), the main centre of the 18th-century Nath saint Baba Mast Nath (born 1764 in Kansreti/Bohar village, Rohtak district, per Wikipedia; hagiography says he lived about a century and is a reincarnation of Guru Gorakhnath). The Math was established by Guru Chauranginath in the 8th century; after neglect, Baba Mast Nath re-established it in 1791, and after he took samadhi his disciples erected the samadhi temple in his honour. It is managed by the Mastnath Math Trust; the annual Baba Mast Nath Mela is held at the samadhi on Phalguna Sudi 7-9 (Feb-Mar), with worship, wrestling matches, Ayurveda camps and community feasts. Baba Mastnath University was established in his name in 2012 by his seventh disciple Mahant Chandnath. TOWN CORRECTION: the CSV town 'Rohtak' is imprecise - the Math is at Asthal Bohar village, recorded here with the corrected town. The 8th-century founding date and hagiographic details rest on oral/local tradition.
